Independent four-ticket reconciler-comment plan audit — 2026-09-05

Immutable source basis: `origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`, also the clean audit worktree HEAD. A read-only comparison through `88c90f8b5abf4a80be3b1289d7719d6e03e29684` found only `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_ref_lock.py` changed under the subsystem and zero overlap with the 72 scoped paths.

Proven inventories:
- `bardlike-nonmystic-chital` (`2f06-c38e-4abb-4a5c`): 18 paths; 31 blocks = 27 owner docstrings + 4 full-line comment regions; 7,159 base words; 253 unlisted prose blocks and 22 directive tokens protected; final description 7,249 characters.
- `bothersome-equatable-flounder` (`2fab-8fa2-1d30-40a9`): 18 paths; 21 blocks = 20 owner docstrings + 1 full-line comment region; 3,840 base words; 249 unlisted prose blocks and 19 directive tokens protected; final description 6,947 characters. Corrected the stale `test_inbound_update_assignee_mint_5200.py:D214-220` range to stable owner `D:test_the_differ_forwards_the_canonical_identity_with_the_assignee` at immutable lines 215-221.
- `epidermoid-fruity-wolf` (`78e5-ec10-733b-4f84`): 18 paths; 22 blocks = 21 owner docstrings + 1 full-line comment region; 3,454 base words; 297 unlisted prose blocks and 13 directive tokens protected; final description 7,189 characters.
- `grisly-guardable-avocet` (`7b5b-09db-1767-481c`): 18 paths; exactly 18 module docstrings; 3,187 base words; 308 unlisted prose blocks and 22 directive tokens protected; final description 7,148 characters.

Combined: 72 unique path rows, 92 editable blocks (86 docstrings + 6 comment regions), 17,640 base words, 1,107 protected unlisted prose blocks, and 76 protected directive tokens. Every allowlist span resolves exactly at the immutable SHA. Consumer searches found no targeted `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, doctest, or pydoc consumer for an editable test docstring. The `test_coordinator_route_census.py` assertion consumes production `create_coordinator.__doc__`, which remains AST-identical.

Each repaired description now uses path-qualified `D:<qualified-owner>` / `C:<anchor>` IDs; names concise and load-bearing exclusions; requires one non-author TSV `PASS` row per block with full immutable/final SHA citations; and separately requires normalized AST/runtime equality, directive/shebang text and attachment, exact `HEAD^..HEAD` paths, focused pytest, scoped Ruff check+format, comment hygiene, diff integrity, and untimed worktree-venv `make verify`.

MCP persisted 72 concrete path-specific file-impact rows and 28 DD records: seven per leaf (`immutable-prose-only`, `exact-leaf-paths`, `focused-tests`, `scoped-ruff`, `comment-hygiene`, `diff-integrity`, `repository-gates`). The immutable oracle replaces only allowlisted leading docstring values, parses with `type_comments=True`, normalizes only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, compares exact attribute-free ASTs, preserves directive/shebang token text plus inline/next-statement attachment, and confines zero-context hunks to declared base spans. All 28 shell commands passed `zsh -n`; all 8 embedded Python programs passed `ast.parse`. Tests and gates were not executed.

All 12 leaf writes returned `result=ok`, `push_status.state=ok`, no description warning, and no cross-session warning. Independent MCP readback matched every description byte-for-byte, every ordered impact array field-for-field, and every command after normalization to `{dd_id, dd_text, command}`. All four remain `open`, `assignee=null`, direct children of `fruity-conclusive-goral`, and `attestations={}`.

Readiness: all four are structurally ready for fresh plan review, but not certified/claim-ready. Per instruction, no plan review, code edit, test, gate, claim, transition, close, code commit, or manual push occurred; only normal MCP tracker-event mutations auto-committed and auto-pushed by rebar.
